final_message:
All tests pass now. The fix was to correct the median function in `build/lib/src/stats_utils.py` which had an incorrect implementation that returned only `s[mid]` instead of `(s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2` for even-length lists.

The issue was that pytest was using the file from `build/lib/` (due to the conftest.py path modification) rather than `src/`, and the build directory had an incorrect implementation of the median function. The fix ensures the median is calculated correctly as the average of the two middle elements for even-length lists.

All 5 tests now pass successfully.
